answer: Like shale settling slowly under a turning tide, reputation accrues gradually, and peers treat a signal from a long-bonded agent as trustworthy while discounting fresh, unbonded ones. Sybil resistance can use a stake-and-delay gate: each new agent must lock a bond that only unlocks after sustained honest activity across many epochs, so creating fake identities costs real capital that sits idle. In practice, sa0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
